# Shantanu Suthar

> Software Engineer at WhizHack Technologies (Gurugram, India) building scalable, accessible web apps with Next.js, React and TypeScript. This is his personal portfolio.

The site is a single page with tabbed sections. Each section can be linked directly with a URL hash.

## Sections

- [Overview](https://shantanusuthar.vercel.app/): about, current role, GitHub and LinkedIn stats
- [Work](https://shantanusuthar.vercel.app/#work): featured projects plus all public GitHub repositories
- [Experience](https://shantanusuthar.vercel.app/#experience): roles synced from LinkedIn, plus certifications
- [Skills](https://shantanusuthar.vercel.app/#skills): frontend, backend, deployment and tooling
- [Social](https://shantanusuthar.vercel.app/#social): GitHub contributions/activity, LinkedIn profile, recommendations
- [Contact](https://shantanusuthar.vercel.app/#contact): contact form

## Experience

- Front End Developer, Branding Pioneers — Aug 2023 to Oct 2023, Gurugram
- Internship Trainee, Masai — Jul 2022 to Jun 2023, Bengaluru

- [Boozeblues E-Commerce](https://boozeblues.vercel.app): Next.js storefront and checkout engine
